report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unverified. Traces show all sampled checkout flows returning 200 across order, inventory, payment, and postgres. Order metrics show v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows no traffic. Deployment record only proves baseline v1.0.0 exists and cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No current evidence establishes a bounded root cause; excluded logs are required.
missing_evidence: Order logs (ev-...-order-logs) excluded from context; needed to confirm or refute checkout error occurrence and cause.
Gateway logs (ev-...-gateway-logs) excluded; needed to verify client-observed checkout error status codes.
Deployment history for order version 2.0.0 (only baseline v1.0.0 record present); needed to test deployment-regression hypothesis.
Error-rate/latency metrics for checkout route itself; current order metrics show only 200s on /v1/orders.
